data.text: The Social Service League

In order inculcate among the students a spirit of service to
the community, the Social Service League organizes Social Service Week every
year comprising awareness programmes and Shramadana. The members of this club actively take part
in many service projects both within and outside the College under the guidance
of their moderator.
The Interact Club

It is a service oriented club. Its members organize many activities such as
Blood Donation Campaign, awareness programmes to prevent Dengue fever,
conducting traffic diversion continually in the morning and afternoon during
school hours etc. Many of the shady and
fruit bearing fruits found in the College compound are the result of the hard
work of the members of the Interact Club.
St. John Ambulance Brigade

The members of St. John Ambulance Brigade render Frist Aid
Services during the festival seasons of the Churches and Temples such as St.
Antony’s Church, Passaiyoor, Nallur and Nainativu Temples and the Shrine of Our
Lady of Good Voyage, Chatti. Their
service rendered during Inter House Athletic Meet and other related events is
very much appreciated.
The Thaninayagam Muthamil Mantram

The objective of the Muthamil Mantram is to foster interest
among students in Tamil Literary works and develop creative skills. To achieve this objective, the Mantram
organizes various competitions on essay writing, debate, drama, poetry and
oratory. The members also organize
Muthamil Vizha every year in which varieties of cultural events such as Naattu
Koothu, Villu Paddu, Paddi Mantram, Dramas etc.
The English Union

Being mindful of the importance of English Language, the
Union makes its efforts to involve all students to develop their English
Language skills. Every year, our
students secure a number of places in the competitions held at Divisional,
Zonal, District and Provincial Levels in various contests. The
Union organizes the Annual English Day Celebration which presents colorful
stage performances including Shakespearean Poetic Dramas.
Scout Troop & Cub Scouts

The members of the Scout Troop are very active. They conduct their regular Patrol Meetings
with their Troop Leader. The scouts
render their services not only at all important College events but also at
Church festivals and public functions outside the College.  The Guard of Honour given by the Scout Troops
to the Guests at the Inter House Athletic Meet is very smart and grandeur.
Catholic Union & Sacred Heart Confraternity

Maintaining the Catholic atmosphere at the College is our
prime concern. The Union and the
Confraternity are mainly involved in promoting it. The Union prepares the
students to conduct the religious services and devotions on First Fridays, at
May Devotions, October Devotions and on special days. The Union also prepares the students for the
Holy Masses on special days throughout the academic year, collects clothes and
food items to distributes to the needy during lent, Oli Vizha and Christmas
carols etc.
Science Union

It is a union for promoting the interests and development of
the Advanced Level Physical and Bio Science streams. The Union helps Science students to
participate in various seminars, workshops and competitions conducted by the
Department of Education, University of Jaffna and many other private
educational institutes. The Union
organizes the Science Day every year and release the annual magazine,
‘’Parinaamam”.
Advanced Level Union

The Advanced Level Union involves in activities related to
the development and welfare of the Advanced Level Students. Such activities include seminars and in-put
talks on various issues relating University education and future career, Annual
Lunch along with Advanced Level Students from invited schools, field trips to
enhance students’ learning etc.
Social Science Union

This is the club where our junior students interact among
themselves and foster knowledge, skills and attitude towards society, be it
local, national or international. This
club organizes exhibitions and make students aware of the news around the world
by visualizing the current affairs on notice board.

Commerce
Union

Since its
inception, the commerce union has been very active and undertake varieties of
activities at the College.  The union members organize competitions
related to Commerce subject, act as Students Bank Managers to promote the habit
of saving among the students by introducing various savings schemes with the
help of different bank staff, celebrate the annual Commerce Day with the
release of the annual magazine ‘Theral’, conduct subject related seminars for
the final year Commerce Stream students etc.
IT Club

The purpose of the IT Club is to enhance the IT
knowledge of the students and promote their interest to participate in IT
related seminars, workshops and competitions.  There are four IT labs at
the College.  The members of the IT Club help the College to take good
care of these labs.
Media Club

It is one of the most important clubs of the College as it
carries all what happen in the College to the outside world.  The College Official Facebook and the Website
are managed and operated by the members of this club.  The members of this club are mostly the IT
learning students of the College.  The
old boys have donated some modern equipment to enhance the quality of the club
which continues to provide a great service to the Patrician Community.
